extension.summary: Patches Aeon Nox 5 for CU LRC Lyrics + DC Artist Artwork DL compatibility
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons (after skin.aeon.nox.5 is installed - script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart are auto-installed as real dependencies). Offers to remove the original, unrelated script.cu.lrclyrics addon if found installed alongside the fork, since the two conflict silently. Patches up to 4 of skin.aeon.nox.5's own files: (1) 1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - hides the topbar.png control that draws a dark band over lyrics text, and adds the rotating-fanart background control used by DC Artist Artwork DL; (2) 1080i/MusicVisualisation.xml - hides the skin's own static fanart background so it can't cover the rotating one; (3) 1080i/Font.xml - fixes missing Slovak/Czech diacritics in 2 of the 5 lyrics display fonts; (4) 1080i/MusicOSD.xml - fixes the OSD Lyrics button calling the pre-fork original addon instead of script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed. Each file gets a one-time backup (.bak) before patching; re-running is a no-op for anything already applied. Restart Kodi afterwards for the changes to take effect. Only tested against Aeon Nox 5 on CoreELEC (Omega) - refuses to touch anything on other skins since the target files won't match.
extension.news: 1.15.1: bumped the required script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed version to match its actual current 1.23.5 (was pointing at 1.23.4, one version stale immediately after that addon's own last bump) - these two addons require each other, so every version bump on either side needs the other's requires updated to match in the same pass, not as an afterthought. 1.15.0: restored the <requires> dependency on script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed, per user request - both addons are genuinely needed together, so a real dependency should exist. Confirmed this Kodi/CoreELEC version's JSON-RPC has no Addons.InstallAddon or Addons.UninstallAddon at all (only ExecuteAddon/GetAddonDetails/GetAddons/SetAddonEnabled exist), so the 1.14.0 soft-install-via-JSON-RPC approach could never have worked here regardless - removed that dead code. With a real <requires>, Kodi's addon manager will always block removing script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed while this addon is installed (by design, protects the dependent) - uninstall this addon first, then script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed. There is no cascade-uninstall in Kodi's addon system and no uninstall-time hook for script addons to trigger one themselves. 1.14.0: removed the <requires> dependency on script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed added in 1.13.0 - confirmed live it makes Kodi's addon manager refuse to uninstall EITHER addon while the other is installed, in both orders, a genuine deadlock through the GUI with no clean way out short of removing files by hand. Replaced with a soft install via Addons.InstallAddon (JSON-RPC) in service.py, run once on startup if script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed isn't found - a fresh Aeon Nox 5 box still ends up with everything working with zero manual steps, but both addons now stay freely, independently uninstallable through the Kodi GUI exactly as before. 1.13.0: service.py now offers a yesno to restart Kodi immediately after auto-applying patches, instead of just a passive notification telling the user to do it themselves - shells out to "systemctl restart kodi" (no native Kodi builtin actually restarts Kodi itself; Quit() only works if the platform happens to auto-relaunch it, not guaranteed) if confirmed. Waits 3s first for the GUI to be up before showing it, since this runs very early in Kodi's startup sequence. 1.12.0: shared the patch logic into a new lib/core.py, and added a service.py (xbmc.service, start="startup") that calls it automatically and silently (no confirmation dialogs - every patch here is idempotent with a .bak kept, so there's nothing destructive to confirm) - per user request, so installing this addon on a fresh Aeon Nox 5 box now genuinely needs zero manual steps: Kodi starts the service immediately on install/enable (not just on the next full boot), which applies every pending patch and removes the conflicting original lyrics addon if present. default.py (Program Add-ons > run) is kept as-is for manual re-runs/debugging, now just a thin wrapper around the same lib/core.py. 1.11.0: restored from the 2026-09-03 backup as the confirmed-last-working baseline (translation, sync slider, everything functional) - script.cu.lrclyrics.advanced is a separate, independent, all-skins project from here on and has nothing to do with this addon. On top of that baseline: (1) now declares script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed as a real <requires> dependency, so installing this addon on a fresh Aeon Nox 5 box auto-installs it too and everything comes up working immediately, no separate manual step; (2) offers to remove the original, unrelated script.cu.lrclyrics addon if found installed alongside the fork - Kodi's dependency system has no notion of "conflicts with", so both could end up installed side by side; (3) new 4th patch, MusicOSD.xml - the OSD Lyrics button (control 703) was hardcoded to RunScript(script.cu.lrclyrics), the pre-fork original addon id, not script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed - confirmed present even in the 2026-09-03 backup, so this was a pre-existing silent bug, not a regression; now targets the fork correctly. 1.10.0: the translation credit box is now smaller again (height 82 to 62, another 75%) and moved further down to stay directly above the translation panel with the same half-height gap rule (top 647 to 677, gap now 31px instead of 41px). 1.9.0: the translation credit box (group id 141) is now smaller (height 110 to 82, 75%), moved down to sit directly above the translation panel with a gap equal to half its own height (top 580 to 647, so its bottom is now 41px above the panel's top at 770), and its background opacity now matches the translation panel's own (colordiffuse C0000000 to 80000000) instead of being more opaque than it. Also added a dedicated smaller font_translation_source (20 vs 28) to Font.xml for the translation-panel source textbox only, leaving the translated lyric lines' own font unchanged. 1.8.0: moved the translation-panel source textbox up (top 975 to 940) - at height 70 it was overflowing the panel's bottom edge by 5px (panel bottom is 1040). 1.7.0: the translation-panel source strip is now a 2-line textbox (was a single-line label) so a hybrid human+machine result can show its coverage percentage on its own line instead of being truncated. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.21.0+ to actually populate the second line. 1.6.0: adds a translation-credit overlay (group id 141) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - once the last timed lyric line has passed, if a human translation source was used (never for DeepL/Google/Lingva), shows a "translation by X, support them at Y" message for ~25s in the now-idle lyrics area. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.16.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.5.0: seek-progress overlay repositioned to the top of the screen and widened to match the translation panel's width/left margin (45,1830 instead of 360,1200), instead of the centered box over the middle of the lyrics text. 1.4.0: adds a seek-progress overlay (group id 140) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - a translucent progress bar plus elapsed/total time and the +/-amount just seeked, shown briefly on left/right during timed or untimed lyrics, using the skin's own osd/texturebg_cache.png + osd/midtexture.png textures and Player.Progress/Player.Time/Player.Duration infolabels so the bar itself needs no per-frame Python updates. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.11.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.3.0: now patches skin.aeon.nox.5.skinbase too, not just skin.aeon.nox.5 - skinbase is Aeon Nox 5's own pristine copy of itself, used by the skin's built-in "reset to default" feature, and was silently missing all 4 patches (confirmed by direct comparison: none of the 3 patched files matched, and script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml did not exist there at all). A skin reset would have reverted every fix in this addon without warning. 1.2.0: adds a 4th file, script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml - a dedicated, wide window for the lyrics sync-offset slider (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics), instead of reusing the skin's shared DialogSlider.xml (also used for volume/seek/brightness everywhere else in Kodi). Unlike the other 3 patched files, this one is a brand new file this addon introduces rather than an existing file it patches, so it needs no .bak backup. Also adds font_sync to Font.xml for it. 1.1.0: now patches all 3 skin files this repo ships overrides for (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml, MusicVisualisation.xml, Font.xml) in one run with a single combined confirmation, instead of only the lyrics topbar file - the other two were previously manual-copy-only (skin-overrides/) and easy to miss, and script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart now declare this addon as a real <requires> dependency so Kodi installs it alongside them automatically. 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.
